m=C().f
print(*dir(m))

class C:
 def f(self): return 7
m=C().f
m.__func__.tag=7
a=dir(m)
b=dir(m)
a.append("copy")
print(a is b,"tag" in b,"copy" in b,list(m.__dict__)==["tag"])

class C:
 def f(self): return 7
m=C().f
a=dir(m)
m.__func__.tag=7
b=dir(m)
m.__func__.tag=9
print("tag" in a,"tag" in b,len(dir(m))==len(b))
del m.__func__.tag
print("tag" in dir(m),"tag" in b)

class C:
 def f(self): return 7
m=C().f
f=m.__func__
f.old=7
a=dir(m)
f.__dict__={"fresh":9}
b=dir(m)
print("old" in a,"old" in b,"fresh" in b,m.__dict__ is f.__dict__)

class C:
 def f(self): return 7
m=C().f
key="__fu"+"nc__"
m.__func__.__dict__={key:7}
r=dir(m)
print([n for n in r if n=="__func__"][0] is key,len(r))

class C:

m=C().f
d=m.__dir__

del C
f.tag=7
print("tag" in d(),d.__self__.__func__ is f)

class Callable: pass
c=Callable()
m=classmethod(c).__get__(None,object)
def lookup(self,name):
 print(name)
 return object.__getattribute__(self,name)
Callable.__getattribute__=lookup
print(len(dir(m)))

c=Callable()
m=classmethod(c).__get__(None,object)
